title: 재외공관 무관주재령 시행규칙 / queue:ARTICLE:2:0:00002:part:1/1
full_text:
Article 2 (Definitions)
The terms used in these Rules are defined as follows:
1. "Diplomatic mission abroad" means an embassy, legation, representative office, consulate general or consulate of the Republic of Korea established in a foreign country.
2. "Military Attache Office at a Diplomatic Mission Abroad" means an organization through which officers of the Armed Forces under Article 2 of the Decree on the Stationing of Military Attaches at Diplomatic Missions Abroad (hereinafter referred to as the "Decree") (hereinafter referred to as "stationed military attaches") perform their duties at a diplomatic mission abroad.
